findings.title: getDisputesForCheck panel vs cached OC badge timing worth a note
findings.problem: getDisputesForCheck is correctly uncached (no staleness bug). But the accuracy-checks page shows the uncached per-check panel alongside the cached OC badge counts, so after a mutation they can momentarily differ on screen. Behavior-preserving (OC invalidates on every dispute write), not a correctness regression, but easy to misread as a cache bug.
findings.fix: Doc-only: add to the getDisputesForCheck skip rationale that its per-check panel is always a fresh fetch and reconciles with the cached badge counts on the next OC invalidation, so no extra wiring is needed.

findings.title: mergeMasters 'one clear suffices' depends on no meta read between Step 3 and return
findings.problem: Clearing M once after Step 3 covering the Step-4 re-grades is correct only because nothing reads M between Step 3 and the function returning. True today (Step 4 is a tight server loop with no getAccuracyChecksMeta call), but the invariant is load-bearing and only implied.
findings.fix: Doc-only: state explicitly that no get...Meta() runs between Step 3 and return, so a single post-Step-3 clear suffices; if a future edit adds a meta read inside Step 4, re-clear after the loop.

findings.title: fixStaleMasterTotals placement wording contradicts its resilient control flow
findings.where: §2 Wiring mechanics, single-write bullet parenthetical on fixStaleMasterTotals
findings.problem: fixStaleMasterTotals loops and continues on per-row error (never throws out of the loop), so 'place the invalidate immediately after that write's if (error) throw guard' does not literally apply - there is no throwing guard. The parenthetical does say a single clear after the loop is fine (the correct instruction), but the lead-in rule and the exception read as mildly contradictory.
findings.fix: Doc-only: move fixStaleMasterTotals out of the single-write/clear-after-throw-guard bullet and group it with the resilient-loop shapes - clear M once on the unconditional normal return, like backfillPlayerAccuracy.
